title: CAS-06731 — Dubai Travel Advertisement — RTÉ Radio 1
text:
Programme: Dubai Travel Advertisement
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ Radio 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 12.01.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Obligations 13.2 (f) and 13.2 (e) of the General Commercial Communications Code
Short description: The complaint is about a short advertisement promoting travel to Dubai. The complaint alleges the statement, “a little getaway never hurt anyone” misleads listeners by presenting discretionary flying as harmless, when it is harmful to the environment.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
